title: JWT decoder: decode a JSON Web Token online
description: Paste a JWT to see its header and payload as readable JSON, the exp, iat and nbf times in your time zone, and whether the token has expired. The token never leaves your browser.

ui.noVerify: This token’s signature isn’t verified here: RS and ES algorithms need the server’s public key. Anyone can read a JWT, so never trust its contents until the signature has been checked.
ui.noSignature: No signature — an unsecured token (alg: none)

errors.parts: A JWT has three parts separated by dots (found: {count})
errors.jwe: This is an encrypted token (JWE, five parts): its contents can't be read without the key
errors.base64: The {part} is not valid Base64URL: it contains invalid characters or is cut off
errors.json: The {part} decodes, but it isn't JSON
errors.object: The {part} must be a JSON object in curly braces

ui.verifyNote: To verify the signature, enter the secret below: it’s checked in your browser and never sent anywhere. Still, avoid pasting production secrets into websites.
ui.sampleSecret: the sample token’s secret is qdbp
ui.sigOk: Signature verified: the token was signed with this secret and hasn’t been changed.
ui.sigBad: Invalid signature: a different secret, or the token was modified.
